items: Agent package exports BaselineAgent and RECAAgent.
BaselineAgent implements parameter state, epsilon-greedy action choice and simple scalar reward adaptation without structural mechanism change.
RECAAgent implements consequence memory, numeric candidate mutations, heuristic modification scoring/acceptance, retained parameter states and D_c/C_e/A_c/GV proxy functions.
Code leaves mechanism-level identity and future-horizon semantics unresolved.
Environment package exports BaseEnvironment and GridWorld.
GridWorld implements finite-grid state, reset, noisy transitions, numeric reward and goal/obstacle behavior.
reca_vs_baseline defines comparison-result structure and an in-memory toy comparison between BaselineAgent and RECAAgent.
Toy comparison does not itself specify the complete documented multi-seed perturbation/ablation/long-horizon protocol.
Perturbation helper applies callback-driven environment perturbation and tracks pre/post/recovery rewards.
Reward recovery does not itself identify which internal structural change caused it.
LongHorizonTester expects environment/transition viability APIs and records long-horizon reward, viability, perturbation and structural-event information.
Long-horizon tester delegates viability semantics to its environment rather than defining universal G_V.
